# Expected behavior

- Mark every satisfied acceptance item `[x]`.
- Record one concise Final verification summary after the final implementation change.
- Include each final check's outcome and the acceptance it demonstrates.
- Link the verified revision, PR, CI run, release, or delivered artifact when one exists without requiring a new commit.
- Remove the transient Recovery checkpoint and omit chronological intermediate test runs.
- Mark the task `completed` only when acceptance and final verification agree.
